infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Customers: your location finds technicians near you and sets the job address. Technicians: while you're online, your location shows you on customers' maps and, when you're on the way to a job, gives that customer your live position and ETA. Location is only used while the app is open.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Take photos of the job, receipts, price evidence and your portfolio.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Attach photos of the job, receipts, price evidence and your portfolio.
